command: python3 scripts/verify_staged.py start; synchronous next batches; then finish. Exact invocations and compiler argv are recorded in process_record.json and RESULTS.json.
mathematical_claim: In every membership structure satisfying the unchanged encoded ZFC theory, the unchanged regular-uncountable guard implies internal small-product closure. The proof constructs internal bounded rankings, derives binary-union closure, uses definable induction for ordinal rectangles and bounds rank images rowwise. Consequently the original internal complete-filter extension premise implies fine complete-ultrafilter existence, internal constraint compactness and residual reflection. The actual productArithmeticSentence and guardedExtensionCompactnessSentence are semantic consequences of encoded ZFC. An assumed model of KZFC has an internal guarded compactness witness; no model existence is concluded.
input_domain: Arbitrary membership structures satisfying encoded ZFC; internal set-coded injection witnesses, function graphs, relation tables, scopes, ultrafilters and completeness. No external-cardinality or powerset correctness assumption.
tested_surrogate: Fresh proof elaboration, exhaustive named theorem axiom audit, predecessor source equality, expected rejection controls. Mathematical universal conclusions derive from the proof terms, not from finite enumeration.

bounds.build_strategy: Clean serial targets in hash-pinned resumable batches

pass_means: Every compilation succeeds, every named theorem is audited, axiom dependencies satisfy the standard allowlist, input hashes are unchanged, predecessor theorem sources match, and false proof and placeholder controls are rejected for the expected reasons.
failure_means: No final PASS or claim that all proofs checked. Compiler, audit, integrity or resource failures must be reported separately.
non_claims: No uncountable compactness cardinal, truth of Theta or KZFC model is proved to exist or introduced as an axiom.
The internal compactness-to-complete-filter-extension converse and therefore the full arbitrary-model equivalence remain unfinished.
The arithmetic, union-closure, and ranking statements are proved, not inserted as axioms or extra fields of AxiomSemantics. Guard, zfcTheory, kzfcTheory and Theta are unchanged.
All-model results are semantic consequence proofs, not a separately exported first-order proof-calculus derivation.
No external well-foundedness, cardinality, powerset or function absoluteness of arbitrary models is assumed.
No independence, relative consistency, new consistency strength or priority claim; no arbitrary higher-derived residual classification.
